add a control for push_cstr_or_null's error arm and its NULL/<NULL> rendering

residuals: No Miri/ASan, no build and no test execution.
The six controls above are missing; the discharge condition 'every guard has a load-bearing mutation control' therefore fails on the same test B48 used to refuse its 67-row application.
The review establishes contracts, not runtime behaviour.
required_resolution: add C1-C5 controls, run C6, then obtain a fresh adjudication; only then apply the nine sites. Until then the applied ledger keeps them REVIEW_REQUIRED.
non_claims: This review does not discharge or apply the nine sites.
